atoms.text:
Text 1:
Portia the cat is resting in her favourite spot on the comfy sofa in the living room. The spot is high enough that the slobbering dog can’t easily disturb her and is also directly in front of the window, so she can enjoy the view and the warm rays of the sun. Her owner is gone for the day, and she is officially on watch duty. She just hopes Bast won’t be too much of an issue today by barking at all the squirrels running around. She finds that so annoying.

atoms.text:
Text 2:
Bast the dog is excited for the day. After his owner goes, he has to complete his daily to-do list. First on his list is annoying Portia. He jumps up on the sofa and tries to lick her. Then, he barks at his friend Frodo, who is on his daily walk. By now Bast is tired. He chooses his favourite spot on the rug in the living room, right in front of the window where he can soak up the sun, and has a nap.
